title: Study & Learning
description: IELTS Speaking Part 1 · Học tập và kỹ năng

questions.question: What subject do you enjoy studying the most?

followUps.reason: Why is this subject interesting to you?
followUps.example: Can you give an example of something you recently learned?
followUps.detail: What do you find challenging about it?

questions.question: Do you prefer studying alone or in a group?

followUps.reason: Why is that method better for you?
followUps.example: Can you describe a recent study session?
followUps.detail: When would you choose the other method?

questions.question: What helps you concentrate when you study?

followUps.reason: Why does that help you focus?
followUps.example: Tell me about a time it worked well.
followUps.detail: Does it always work, or only for certain subjects?

questions.question: Would you like to learn a new skill?

followUps.reason: Why is that skill useful to you?
followUps.example: How might you use it in real life?
followUps.detail: What would be difficult about learning it?
